methodology.uncertainty: Across-seed intervals describe optimizer variability on fixed synthetic cases, not clinical effectiveness. Pair by family, scenario and seed. Small n must remain visible.
methodology.feasibility: Returned-solution feasibility and operational feasible-shot rate differ from strict encoded equality feasibility. The latter is an exact statevector probability, not a sampled rate.
methodology.runtime: Recorded full-review wall_seconds includes QUBO construction and solver pipeline, excludes independent analysis. Classical rows are actual repeated calls; no duplicated pseudo-observations.
methodology.gaps: Objective differences are defined only for feasible solutions with an exact reference. Raw arithmetic differences are retained in raw_absolute_gap and raw_relative_gap. Display gaps with absolute difference <= 1e-9 objective units normalize to zero for numerical tolerance. Relative gap is a fraction; zero reference with a nonzero normalized gap is undefined.
methodology.resources: Aer operation counts are not native-device gate counts. Basis-resource fixtures are all-to-all and unrouted. Peak RSS is measured process high-water memory; scaling byte estimates are analytical statevector storage.
methodology.hardware: No physical QPU execution evidence. Training uses exact statevectors; sample counts are simulator measurements.
methodology.missing: Unavailable and skipped measurements remain null. No extrapolated observations.
methodology.confidence: Historical warm comparison has three paired seeds. Show individual observations; a smooth distribution is descriptive, not additional samples.

conditions.interpretation: Three paired seeds on one synthetic instance; LP seed already optimal. Sampling density is not computational advantage.
